name: promptlings
description: Promptlings marketplace for Claude Code. Currently distributes the code review agents; the other promptlings stay install-by-hand.

plugins.name: promptlings-code-review
plugins.description: Two pull request review agents. the-nitcracker flags defects inline and writes a narrative walkthrough; pr-walkthrough writes orientation only. Both split output into defects, design forks, and implicit bets, and render judgment on defects alone.
